Add a source with its licence in the same PR as the first record from it (a tooling PR). `corpora` names the source checkout the generator reads for a library (repo + commit, `path` when the Lake project is a subdirectory of it) and its `roots`, the lean_lib module roots its records come from (`equational_theories`; `Carleson`, `Solution`); a library without one has data-only records that are never compiled.
$comment_translations: Sources that are existing formal libraries: a record from one of these is a translation. Anything else is original work.
